summary_1line: Bhishma and Drona counsel Dhritarashtra to make peace by granting the Pandavas half the kingdom and restoring them honorably.

image_candidates.scene_text: In the royal court, the aged Bhishma rises before Dhritarashtra and Duryodhana, solemnly urging that half the kingdom be given to the Pandavas.
Drona stands among the Kuru elders outlining a plan to send rich gifts and a messenger to Drupada to welcome the Pandavas back to Hastinapura.
